owner_report: One saved move disabled subsequent movement
root_cause: Client JSON string equality retained field order; PostgreSQL JSONB returned equivalent geometry in a different field order. Valid saves failed client verification.
before_fix: New database-shaped controller fixture and equality regression failed against the previous implementation.
fix: Canonicalize fields before comparing geometry. Preserve scope, user, timestamp and value checks. Remove design form and expose only Arrange/Done, contextual Undo and Reset layout.

verification.sequential_model_moves: Six saves plus Undo plus another save passed with database-ordered responses
verification.database_integration: PGlite JSONB save response passes the exact client comparator
verification.deployed_browser_preview: Three consecutive cross-column native mouse drags saved and left movement enabled; click-to-move, Undo, Reset, Done and reload passed
verification.ci: All four implementation workflows and website deployment passed

limits: Browser preview uses production controller/grid with fictional content and tab-local storage; no newly signed-in owner session or physical touch test is claimed.
data_changes: No property, subscription, provider, schema or real customer layout modified by acceptance.
